card.name: Joints before numbers and drug lists
card.fires_on: Small joining spots in dosing and drug-combination text: a space before a number, a comma, slash or the word plus between drug names, or containing before doses.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space right before a duration or dose number.
modes.example: Complete or update vaccination for encapsulated bacteria at least<< >>2 weeks prior to the first dose of

modes.label: Joiner between drugs
modes.description: Plus, a slash or a comma linking drug names in a combination list.
modes.example: darunavir plus ritonavir, fosamprenavir, fosamprenavir plus ritonavir, elbasvir<< plus>> grazoprevir or letermov

modes.label: Containing before amounts
modes.description: The word containing after a fixed-dose combination product, leading into component doses.
modes.example: DELSTRIGO is a fixed-dose combination product<< containing>> 100 mg of dorav

card.plain: It fires on the small joints, like a space, comma, slash or plus, that sit just before the next drug name or number in dosing and combination text.
